info.description: Centralized source of truth for AI prompts, API keys, and business settings

system_prompt_strategy.default: You are a professional restaurant marketing strategist specializing in Algerian market dynamics.

system_prompt_image_gen.default: Generate a high-end, appetizing image of {dish_name} with a luxury minimalist aesthetic.

agent_system_prompt.default: You are Ralphé, a professional AI assistant for an Algerian restaurant chain. You MUST only answer questions related to the restaurant menu, orders, delivery, and promotions. Never invent menu items. If unsure, say 'Let me check with the team.'

system_prompt_video_gen.default: Create a 5-second cinematic food reveal video. Camera slowly orbits the dish. Warm golden lighting. Shallow depth of field. Steam rising. Brand: {brand_name}.

facebook_page_access_token.description: Facebook Page access token for publishing and ads

instagram_business_account_id.description: Instagram Business Account ID for publishing via Graph API

meta_ad_account_id.description: Meta Ads account ID (without act_ prefix)

auto_ad_budget_multiplier.description: Global multiplier for AI ad budget calculations

ad_roas_pause_threshold.description: ROAS below this after 24h triggers auto-pause

darija_patterns.default: wash, kifach, bghit, fin, mchaha, dkhalt, chnou
darija_patterns.description: Comma-separated keywords for Moroccan Arabic detection

sticky_ar_threshold_mins.description: Minutes to keep session in Arabic after detection

handoff_keywords.default: agent, human, help, support, assist, helpme, aide, human
handoff_keywords.description: Keywords that trigger human support handoff

allowed_audio_domains.description: Allowed domains for voice note media URLs

max_voice_note_duration_sec.description: Maximum duration in seconds for processing voice notes

l10n_sticky_ar_enabled.description: Keep Arabic session sticky after N Arabic-script messages

l10n_sticky_ar_threshold.description: Number of Arabic-script messages before sticky AR activates

strict_ar_out.description: Force Arabic output when Arabic script detected in input

support_enabled.description: Enable human support handoff via keywords

delivery_address_max_attempts.description: Max retries for address clarification before handoff

messenger_page_id.description: Facebook Messenger Page ID for sending DMs

messenger_api_token.description: Messenger Page Access Token for Graph API

messenger_send_url.description: Override Messenger send URL (auto-built from page_id if empty)

ig_page_id.description: Instagram Professional Account ID for sending DMs

ig_api_token.description: Instagram API token for Graph API

ig_send_url.description: Override Instagram send URL (auto-built from ig_page_id if empty)

stt_max_duration_sec.description: Maximum audio duration to send to STT API

llm_fallback_model.description: Fallback LLM model if primary fails

outbox_max_attempts.description: Max retry attempts for outbound message delivery

outbox_max_delay_sec.description: Max delay cap for exponential backoff (seconds)

outbox_async_enabled.description: Queue messages for async worker instead of sending inline

outbox_redis_ttl_sec.description: Redis TTL for outbox entries (7 days default)

supabase_url.description: Supabase REST API URL for KDS and real-time

supabase_anon_key.description: Supabase anonymous key for KDS ticket sync

menu_cache_ttl_sec.description: Menu cache duration in seconds (5 min default)

menu_image_url.description: URL to a visual menu image sent with SHOW_MENU

restaurant_lat.description: Restaurant latitude for driver dispatch calculations

restaurant_lng.description: Restaurant longitude for driver dispatch calculations

kiosk_default_service_mode.description: Default service mode for kiosk orders (sur_place, a_emporter)

kiosk_idle_timeout_sec.description: Seconds of inactivity before kiosk resets

cart_abandonment_delay_min.description: Minutes before cart abandonment reminder is sent

vip_win_back_delay_days.description: Days of inactivity before VIP win-back message

kitchen_load_threshold.description: Number of active orders before adding extra ETA time

kitchen_load_extra_min.description: Extra minutes added to ETA when kitchen is overloaded

delivery_fee_multiplier.description: Global multiplier applied to delivery fees

delivery_eta_base_min.description: Base ETA in minutes before distance factor

delivery_eta_per_km_min.description: Minutes added per km of delivery distance

surge_multiplier_max.description: Maximum surge pricing multiplier for delivery

surge_rain_bonus.description: Extra surge multiplier added during rain/bad weather

chargily_public_key.description: Chargily public API key for payment initiation

chargily_webhook_secret.description: Chargily webhook signature secret for payment callbacks

twilio_account_sid.description: Twilio Account SID for voice calls

twilio_auth_token.description: Twilio Auth Token for voice calls

twilio_phone_number.description: Twilio phone number for outbound calls

vapi_api_key.description: VAPI API key for AI voice agent

cart_abandon_template.description: WhatsApp template name for cart abandonment messages

vip_winback_template.description: WhatsApp template name for VIP win-back messages

review_url.description: Google Review URL for the restaurant

printer_api_url.description: Kitchen cloud printer API endpoint (e.g. Star CloudPRNT)

kds_supabase_table.description: Supabase table name for Kitchen Display System sync

predictive_reorder_days.description: Days of history to analyze for predictive stock reordering

redis_url.description: Redis connection URL for outbox, DLQ, and caching
